messages:
kevin: quick sync — RidgeView is ready to run a POC. They want to serve a custom variant (ridge-7b+kvcache+int4) and need: compatibility checklist, cost estimate for a 100 qps sustained POC, and answers for the security questionnaire. Can eng + security weigh in?

mira: pinging on model fit. ridge-7b base looks fine but int4 quant + kvcache variant needs validation for our kv cache hotpath. main question: do they expect long context (8k+) or short chat?

kevin: mostly short (<=1024) but a few retrieval flows that hit ~4k. They care about latency under 120ms p50 and cost cap.

oz: from infra side: we can run this on Dedicated pool. For 100 qps with int4 we estimate ~4 A100-equivalent GPU slots with batching. Ballpark POC monthly commit: $28k-$35k depending on reserved burst. I can give a breakdown.

mira: action items for compatibility:
- validate kv cache eviction semantics with ridge-7b-kv variant
- run warmup profiles for 4k context and measure kv cache hit/miss
- confirm attention kernel supports int4 path for this arch

ellie: I'm prepping the security questionnaire answers. They asked about KMS + BYOK. We support customer-managed KMS for Private and Dedicated; need to confirm flows for rotating per-POC keys. @leah any red flags?

leah: no hard blockers for BYOK in Dedicated. For Private we'll need their network topology and MFA on admin accounts. Also clarify data retention: we keep logs for 30d by default; can extend. I'll send a short checklist.

kevin: can you post the checklist here? I need to share with RidgeView by EOD.

leah: checklist (short):
- network: allowlist IPs + VPC peering details
- KMS: key ARN + rotation policy
- data: retention & purge SLA
- access: list of engineers w/ SSO + role mappings
- compliance: SOC2/ISO artifacts request

mira: quick compat note: if retrieval calls re-use prefixes a lot, our prefix cache can cut token cost by ~20-30%. We'll include a sim.

oz: pricing sketch (POC 30 days, 100 qps, int4):
- infra (GPU hours): $18k
- reserved throughput buffer & ops: $6k
- support & onboarding: $3k
- optional security package (KMS review, extra retention): $2k
= ~$29k (estimate)

kevin: perfect. Can we also confirm model variant packaging steps? I want to tell them the onboarding ETA.

mira: variant onboarding ETA:
1) model upload & integrity checks — 1 day
2) quantization & kernel selection run — 1 day
3) kvcache warmup + perf runs (short & 4k dist) — 2 days
4) canary on Dedicated + SLA test — 1 day
Total: ~5 working days assuming no infra blockers.

ellie: I'll attach a short doc with security answers and the questionnaire draft. Link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/presales/ridgeview-poc-draft

kevin: awesome. next steps: @mira run quick perf sim and drop numbers here, @oz finalize pricing table, @leah send checklist doc, @ellie share the questionnaire. I'll sync with RidgeView and schedule kickoff for Mon. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: build/ridge-7b-kv-quant perf-tests — started (id: brc-8342)

mira: started perf sim now; will post results in ~3h.

oz: I'll post a line-item pricing JSON later today.

leah: checklist doc posted to thread (uploaded).

kevin: thanks everyone — I’ll close the loop with RidgeView after we have the perf numbers.
